resultats.label: Match result
resultats.subtitle: Who wins the match at the end of regular time?

auto.label: Best auto pick
auto.desc: The algorithm automatically selects the market with the highest probability among all those available for this match.

1.label: 1 — Home win
1.desc: The home team wins the match at the end of regular time. Lost if draw or away win.

X.label: X — Draw
X.desc: Both teams finish the match with the same number of goals. Lost if either team wins.

2.label: 2 — Away win
2.desc: The visiting team wins the match. Lost if draw or home win.

doublechance.label: Double chance
doublechance.subtitle: You cover 2 outcomes out of 3 — safer, reduced odd.

1X.label: 1X — Home or Draw
1X.desc: Won if home win OR draw. Lost only if the away team wins. Ideal for backing a strong home team without risking the draw.

X2.label: X2 — Draw or Away
X2.desc: Won if draw OR away win. Lost only if the home team wins. Good choice when the away side is favourite or solid.

12.label: 12 — Home or Away (no draw)
12.desc: Won if either team wins. Lost only in case of a draw. Perfect when a draw seems unlikely between two attacking teams.

dnb.label: Draw No Bet
dnb.subtitle: Draw No Bet — your stake is refunded if the match is a draw.

dnb1.label: DNB Home — Bet void if draw
dnb1.desc: Won if home wins. Stake refunded if draw. Lost if away wins. Less risky than a simple 1 — covers against the draw.

dnb2.label: DNB Away — Bet void if draw
dnb2.desc: Won if away wins. Stake refunded if draw. Lost if home wins. Ideal for backing a visiting team without fearing the draw.

overunder.label: Total goals
overunder.subtitle: Bet on the total number of goals scored in the match.

over05.label: Over 0.5 goals — At least 1 goal
over05.desc: Just one goal needs to be scored in the match to win. Very high probability (~97%). Low but safe odd.

over15.label: Over 1.5 goals — At least 2 goals
over15.desc: The match must have at least 2 goals in total. Very common in attacking matches. Solid bet on scoring teams.

over25.label: Over 2.5 goals — At least 3 goals
over25.desc: The match must total 3 goals or more (e.g. 2-1, 3-0, 2-2). The most popular Over/Under market on 1xbet.

over35.label: Over 3.5 goals — At least 4 goals
over35.desc: High-scoring match with 4 goals or more (e.g. 2-2, 3-1, 4-0). Good odd, recommended for derbies or attack-heavy matches.

over45.label: Over 4.5 goals — At least 5 goals
over45.desc: Very open match with 5 goals or more. High odd, recommended for matches between very attacking or defensively weak teams.

under15.label: Under 1.5 goals — Maximum 1 goal
under15.desc: The match ends with 0 or 1 goal. Bet on a closed, defensive match. Won if score is 0-0, 1-0 or 0-1.

under25.label: Under 2.5 goals — Maximum 2 goals
under25.desc: At most 2 goals in the match (0-0, 1-0, 0-1, 1-1, 2-0, 0-2). Suited to tense matches, cup games, or strong defences.

under35.label: Under 3.5 goals — Maximum 3 goals
under35.desc: The match has 3 goals or fewer. Good probability in balanced matches. Won if final score is 2-1, 1-1, 2-0, etc.

under45.label: Under 4.5 goals — Maximum 4 goals
under45.desc: The match doesn't exceed 4 goals. High probability (~80%). Lost only for very high-scoring matches (5 goals or more).

btts.label: Both teams to score
btts.subtitle: Both Teams To Score — does each team score at least once?

btts.label: BTTS Yes — Both teams score
btts.desc: Both teams score at least 1 goal each (e.g. 1-1, 2-1, 1-2, 2-2). The exact score doesn't matter, only that both teams find the net.

nobtts.label: BTTS No — At least one team fails to score
nobtts.desc: At least one of the two teams finishes the match without scoring. Won if score is 1-0, 0-2, 2-0, or 0-0. Recommended when a team has a very solid defence.

whatIsFpronix.a: fpronix is a football statistics and predictions platform. It lets you follow matches in real time, check tipster analyses, and use data-driven decision-support tools.

sportsBetting.a: No. fpronix is exclusively an information and statistics platform. We do not offer any sports betting service and are not affiliated with any gambling operator. Published predictions are personal opinions, not guarantees.

whoCanUse.a: Anyone aged 18 or older. Some features (publishing predictions, access to advanced data) require a Premium account.

createAccount.q: How do I create an account?
createAccount.a: Click "Sign up" in the top right, enter your email and choose a password. Signing up is free.

freeVsPremium.q: What's the difference between FREE and Premium?
freeVsPremium.a: The FREE plan gives you access to matches, standings, and other tipsters' predictions. The Premium plan (8.99 USD/month) lets you publish your own predictions, access AI analysis (Claude), advanced data, and team lineups.

howToPay.q: How do I pay for Premium?
howToPay.a: We accept Wave, Orange Money, Free Money, and credit card via CinetPay and FedaPay. Go to the "Subscription" page to choose your payment method.

cancelSub.a: Yes, at any time from your profile. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period — you keep access until the expiration date.

forgotPassword.q: I forgot my password, what should I do?
forgotPassword.a: Click "Forgot password" on the login page. A reset link will be sent to your email.

dataSource.q: Where does the match data come from?
dataSource.a: Data is automatically synced from FotMob, a recognized source of football data. Syncing happens every 4 hours.

noStats.q: Why do some matches not show statistics?
noStats.a: Detailed statistics (possession, shots, corners) are only available once the match has started. For scheduled matches, only contextual data (form, H2H) is shown.

leaguesAvailable.a: fpronix covers the major African leagues (Senegal, Ivory Coast, Mali, Ghana, Egypt…) as well as major European competitions (Premier League, Ligue 1, La Liga, Serie A, Champions League). The list grows regularly.

howToPublish.q: How do I publish a prediction?
howToPublish.a: You need an active Premium account. Go to a scheduled match's page, select your prediction, choose your confidence level (1 to 5), and publish. You can only publish one prediction per match.

rankingWorks.q: How does the tipster ranking work?
rankingWorks.a: The ranking is based on success rate (% of correct predictions) with a minimum of one published prediction. Stats are automatically recalculated after each finished match.

aiAnalysis.a: For each scheduled match, Premium subscribers can trigger an automatic analysis by Claude (Anthropic's AI). The AI analyzes team form, head-to-head history, and stats to suggest a prediction. The limit is 5 analyses per day.

reliablePicks.a: Predictions are user opinions or algorithmic suggestions. They carry no guarantee. Sport is unpredictable — even the best tipsters don't win every time.

reportAbuse.q: How do I report an abusive prediction?
reportAbuse.a: On each prediction's card, click the report icon. Our moderation team will review the report and take appropriate action.

enableNotifs.a: Click the bell icon in the menu. Your browser will ask for permission to send notifications. Once enabled, you'll receive alerts for results and important events.

mobileNotifs.a: Yes, on Android and iOS (Safari) provided you've added fpronix to your home screen or use a compatible browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox).

siteNotLoading.q: The site isn't loading properly, what should I do?
siteNotLoading.a: Try clearing your browser cache (Ctrl+Shift+R or Cmd+Shift+R). If the problem persists, contact us at contact@pronix.sn describing the issue and your browser.

paymentFailed.q: My payment failed but I was charged, what should I do?
paymentFailed.a: Contact us immediately at contact@pronix.sn with your transaction reference. We'll verify the payment and activate your subscription manually if needed.
